landing.announcementBar: ✦ Free trial class — Meet your teacher before you commit. No card required.
landing.heroSub: Live, one-to-one Quran lessons with qualified male and female teachers, from your first letter to fluent recitation. Tajweed, memorisation and Ijazah too.
landing.programsSub: One-to-one pathways for every stage. Start wherever you are, and move on when you are ready.
landing.programTajweedDesc: Perfect your recitation with the rules of Tajweed, from the fundamentals of Makharij to the advanced rules of Ghunnah.
landing.programHifzDesc: A structured memorisation program that takes you from your first surah to the completion of the Qur'an.
landing.pricingSub: Choose the lesson length, then how many lessons a month, from 4 up.
landing.testimonial1Quote: My Tajweed has improved more in three months than in the previous three years. The teacher is incredibly patient and knowledgeable.
landing.testimonial2Quote: My children look forward to every lesson. The teacher makes it fun and engaging while keeping it structured. Highly recommend for families.
landing.testimonial3Quote: As a revert, I was nervous about starting. The experience has been welcoming and non-judgmental from day one.
landing.faq1Q: How does the free trial work?
landing.faq1A: Book a 30-minute session with one of our teachers at a time that suits you. There is no cost and no payment required — you only sign up for a plan if you decide to continue.
landing.faq2A: Yes. After your trial, you can request a specific teacher or let us match you based on your goals, schedule, and preferences.
landing.faq3Q: What if I need to reschedule a lesson?
landing.faq3A: You can reschedule any lesson with at least 24 hours notice through our scheduling system. We understand life gets busy.
landing.faq4A: All teachers hold an ijazah (chain of transmission) in Qur'anic recitation and are vetted for teaching ability, character, and reliability.
landing.faq5Q: Do you offer lessons for kids?
landing.faq5A: Yes — we have a dedicated team of teachers experienced with children aged 5 and up. All sessions for minors include a parent-visible link.
landing.faq6Q: What platform do you use for lessons?
landing.faq6A: Lessons take place via Zoom or Google Meet. You will receive a link before each session. No special software is needed.
landing.footerDesc: An online Quran school. Live, one-to-one lessons with qualified teachers.
landing.kidsSubtitle: Between lessons, children keep practising without noticing. Every game is built around hearing and reading the letters of the Quran.
landing.whyS1Sub: You can't always fit in a lesson. The homework system gives you something clear to do in between, on your phone, whenever you have a free moment.
landing.whyS1C1: Your teacher sets the homework and a deadline. You see what is due and how much time is left.
landing.whyS1C2: Record each verse on your phone. There is no app to install and no password. Close the page halfway and your recordings are still there.
landing.whyS1C3: Your teacher marks the exact word. Tap it to hear your teacher say it, then record that verse again.
landing.whyS2Sub: Every lesson is logged, so your page always shows where you are and how far you have come.
landing.whyS2C1: Pages read, reading quality out of 10, mistakes per page, and your place among students your age.
landing.whyS2C2: Reading, memorisation and mistakes per page, month by month. You can watch the mistakes come down.
landing.whyS2C3: A bar shows how much of the Quran you have read. Milestones mark the way, from Al-Baqarah to the Khatm.
landing.whyS3Sub: Mistakes are marked on the letter and given a name, so you know what to fix before the next lesson.
landing.whyS3C1: Your teacher taps a letter and picks the problem from a wheel of reading mistakes and tajweed rules.
landing.whyS3C2: Each mark shows on your own Quran page with its name, so you can find it again and fix it.
landing.whyS3C3: Two wheels count your mistakes, one for reading and one for tajweed, and name your biggest challenge.
landing.whyS4Sub: Read it, hear it and learn what the words mean, all on the same page.
landing.whyS4C1: Turn the tajweed colours on to see each rule as you read.
landing.whyS4C2: Listen verse by verse. Pick a reciter, slow the speed to half, and repeat each verse up to five times.
landing.whyS4C3: Tadabbur Lab keeps every verse you reflected on. Hear each word, see its meaning and revise the weak ones with flashcards.
landing.whyS5Sub: Practise letters and words in short games, alone or with friends online.
landing.whyS5C1: Pick a Qaedah lesson and practise its words. The squares under each word show how you read it before.
landing.whyS5C2: Hear the letter and race to its flag. Up to 8 friends can play online.
landing.whyS5C3: A monthly board shows the top five students by homework finished. It starts again on the 1st.
landing.whyS6Sub: Your teacher sends you a link. It opens on a phone or a computer, with nothing to install and no password.
landing.whyS6C1: Your calendar shows each lesson in your own time zone, with your teacher's time beside it.
landing.whyS6C2: Turn on phone alerts for new homework and your teacher's replies. They arrive even when the page is closed.
landing.whyS6C3: Switch the page between English, Arabic and Turkish from the top bar.
landing.programQaedahDesc: Learn to read the Quran from the very first letter: letters, vowels and joining, with games to practise between lessons.
landing.programIjazahDesc: Recite the whole Quran to a qualified teacher and earn an Ijazah with a connected Sanad.
landing.game_letterRace_tag: Hear the letter, race to its flag and carry it home. Tackle, jump and play online with friends.
landing.game_letterFlight_tag: Hear a letter and fly to it first, racing your teacher or another player.
landing.game_castleBattle_tag: Answer fast: every correct letter sends a knight into battle.
landing.game_letterCards_tag: Match each letter to its other shape, card for card, against your teacher.
landing.game_flappyLetters_tag: Flap through the sky and catch the letters that build the word.
landing.game_buildTheWord_tag: Listen to a Qaedah word, then drive the crane to stack its letters and vowels in order.
landing.priceMinNote: From 4 lessons a month. Take as many more as you like.
landing.priceFeature2: Homework, progress page and learning games included
landing.priceFeature3: Your first lesson is a free trial
landing.faq7A: Every student pays the same: $10 for a 25-minute lesson or $20 for a 50-minute lesson. Plans start at 4 lessons a month, and you can take as many more as you like.
landing.heroReaderHint: Tap a verse to hear it, hold it to read the meaning.
landing.teachersBody: Our teachers are carefully selected and trained for their mastery of Quran recitation and Tajweed, their English, and the patience to guide every student with understanding and care.
landing.teachersQuote: Knowing how to recite is one thing. Knowing how to teach is another.
landing.tutorCardSub: Apply to join the school. We read every application.
landing.teachersImgAlt: A teacher giving a live Quran lesson on a computer
landing.faqSub: Anything else? Ask us during your free trial.
landing.heroShotAlt: The live lesson page: the teacher marks each mistake on the exact letter
